definitions.gloss: spiritual sensitivity; psychic ability; sixth sense for the supernatural
definitions.explanation: The ability to sense or perceive spirits, ghosts, or supernatural phenomena.
A sudden flash of insight or creative inspiration, as if coming from a higher source.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{霊感|れいかん}が{強|つよ}い。
examples.english: She has a strong spiritual sensitivity.

examples.japanese: {霊感|れいかん}のある{人|ひと}には{幽霊|ゆうれい}が{見|み}えるらしい。
examples.english: Apparently, people with psychic ability can see ghosts.

examples.japanese: あの{古|ふる}い{屋敷|やしき}に{行|い}ったら、{霊感|れいかん}がなくても{何|なに}か{感|かん}じるだろう。
examples.english: If you go to that old mansion, you'd probably feel something even without psychic sensitivity.

examples.japanese: {芸術家|げいじゅつか}にとって{霊感|れいかん}は{大切|たいせつ}だ。
{散歩|さんぽ}をしているときに{霊感|れいかん}を{得|え}た。
examples.english: I received inspiration while taking a walk.

examples.japanese: ベートーヴェンは{自然|しぜん}の{中|なか}から{音楽|おんがく}の{霊感|れいかん}を{受|う}けたと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It is said that Beethoven received musical inspiration from nature.

notes:
Composed of {霊|れい} (spirit, soul) + {感|かん} (feeling, sense). The two senses — supernatural sensitivity and creative inspiration — both carry the idea of perceiving something beyond ordinary awareness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {霊感|れいかん}が{強|つよ}い — to have strong spiritual sensitivity
- {霊感|れいかん}がある — to have psychic ability
- {霊感|れいかん}を{受|う}ける — to receive inspiration
- {霊感|れいかん}を{得|え}る — to gain inspiration
- {霊感|れいかん}{商法|しょうほう} — spiritualist fraud (a scam exploiting belief in spirits)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- インスピレーション — inspiration (loanword; neutral, no supernatural connotation)
- {直感|ちょっかん} — intuition (rational/instinctive, not supernatural)
- {第六感|だいろっかん} — sixth sense (can be supernatural or just strong intuition)
- {超能力|ちょうのうりょく} — supernatural powers (broader; includes telekinesis, telepathy, etc.)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Belief in {霊感|れいかん} is common in Japanese popular culture. TV shows about haunted places and people with spiritual abilities are popular. {霊感|れいかん}{商法|しょうほう} (spiritual fraud) — where scammers claim psychic powers to sell expensive items — is a recognized social problem.
